name: BACH_0141
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (86%)** · Ambiguous: Benign vs Normal · Careful review
Invasive risk is 0% [F1], but conformal set includes Normal and 0/5 neighbors match [F5].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 86%, Normal 14%, InSitu 0%, Invasive 0% | Favors Benign; 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Normal, Benign} (90% coverage) | Cannot separate Benign from Normal |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 8th OOD percentile [F6] | Typical input; unflagged quality |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Independent models concur |
| Similar cases | 0/5 Benign (5/5 Normal, 92%–96%) | Neighbors contradict Benign call |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules** (regions 1, 9, 11) · ↓ invasive · Top benign score (-1.74) [F2], 0/20 spot check · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 2, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · High text score (-0.47) [F3], caption mismatch · Weak
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 6) · context · Low score (+0.44) [F4], 8/20 spot check · Weak
- **Nuclei segmentation** (regions 0, 3, 11) · context · 0% immune [F7], 4% epithelial [F8], 8 neoplastic · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on deletion (+0.0114 vs random, CI 0.0021–0.0197); all 12 regions score 0.
- **Concepts**: Unproven on deletion (CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); relies on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Tissue is Normal breast, matching 5/5 reference cases (92%–96% similarity) and {Normal, Benign} set.
- Unsampled regions hold atypia, or superior/lateral edges (100%/99% scores) involve simulated margins [F9].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 9, 11**: Distinguish benign lesion from normal lobules (Unreliable) and check 5 neoplastic nuclei.
2. **Regions 2, 5, 6**: Confirm benign tubule architecture where text scores are high but captions disagreed.
3. **Regions 3, 7**: Rule out stromal invasion or ductal atypia (top contrast vs Normal BACH_0308).
